
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8"/>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>AlumniConnect — Official Portal</title>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,600&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css"/>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode@1.5.3/build/qrcode.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    :root {
      --navy:       #0a1628;
      --navy-mid:   #112240;
      --navy-light: #1e3a5f;
      --gold:       #d4a017;
      --gold-light: #f0c040;
      --gold-pale:  #fdf3d0;
      --cream:      #faf8f4;
      --white:      #ffffff;
      --gray-100:   #f1f4f9;
      --gray-200:   #dde3ee;
      --text:       #0f1c2e;
      --muted:      #6b7c93;
      --accent:     #3b82f6;
      --green:      #22c55e;
      --red:        #ef4444;
      --r-sm: 10px; --r-md: 16px; --r-lg: 24px; --r-xl: 32px;
      --sh-sm: 0 2px 12px rgba(10,22,40,.07);
      --sh-md: 0 8px 32px rgba(10,22,40,.12);
      --sh-lg: 0 20px 60px rgba(10,22,40,.2);
      --sh-gold: 0 8px 32px rgba(212,160,23,.35);
      --t: .28s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; font-size: 16px; }
    body { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; background: var(--cream); color: var(--text); overflow-x: hidden; }
    h1,h2,h3,.serif { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; }
    img { display: block; }

    /* ── SCROLLBAR ── */
    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--navy); }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--gold); border-radius: 3px; }

    /* ── PRELOADER ── */
    #preloader { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: var(--navy); z-index: 99999; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: opacity .6s ease, visibility .6s ease; }
    #preloader.hidden { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; }
    .loader-ring { width: 60px; height: 60px; border: 3px solid rgba(212,160,23,.2); border-top-color: var(--gold); border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 1s linear infinite; }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    /* ── NAVBAR ── */
    .navbar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 900; background: rgba(10,22,40,.95); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212,160,23,.15); padding: 0 5%; transition: box-shadow var(--t); }
    .navbar.scrolled { box-shadow: var(--sh-lg); }
    .nav-inner { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 66px; }
    .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; }
    .brand-logo { width: 36px; height: 36px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light)); border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); box-shadow: var(--sh-gold); }
    .brand-text { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; letter-spacing: -.3px; }
    .brand-text em { color: var(--gold); font-style: normal; }
    .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2px; list-style: none; align-items: center; }
    .nav-links a { color: rgba(255,255,255,.72); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: .88rem; letter-spacing: .2px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 8px; transition: background var(--t), color var(--t); }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--gold); background: rgba(212,160,23,.1); }
    .nav-cta { background: var(--gold) !important; color: var(--navy) !important; padding: 8px 20px !important; border-radius: 50px !important; margin-left: 8px; }
    .nav-cta:hover { background: var(--gold-light) !important; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--sh-gold); }
    .hamburger { display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; cursor: pointer; background: none; border: none; padding: 4px; }
    .hamburger span { display: block; width: 22px; height: 2px; background: #fff; border-radius: 2px; transition: var(--t); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px,5px); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px,-5px); }
    @media(max-width:800px) {
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .nav-links { display: none; flex-direction: column; position: absolute; top: 66px; left: 0; right: 0; background: rgba(10,22,40,.98); padding: 16px 5%; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold); }
      .nav-links.open { display: flex; }
    }

    /* ── HERO ── */
    .hero { min-height: 92vh; position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 100px 20px 80px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--navy); }
    .hero-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1562774053-701939374585?w=1800&auto=format&fit=crop&q=85') center/cover no-repeat; opacity: .38; }
    .hero-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 40%, rgba(212,160,23,.18) 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 80%, rgba(59,130,246,.12) 0%, transparent 55%), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10,22,40,.45) 0%, rgba(10,22,40,.72) 100%); }
    .hero-particles { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; }
    .hero-particles span { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold); animation: float var(--dur, 8s) var(--delay, 0s) ease-in-out infinite alternate; opacity: var(--op, .15); }
    @keyframes float { from { transform: translate(0,0); } to { transform: translate(var(--tx,20px), var(--ty,-30px)); } }
    .hero-inner { position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 760px; }
    .hero-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(212,160,23,.15); color: var(--gold-light); border: 1px solid rgba(212,160,23,.3); padding: 7px 20px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 1.4rem; animation: fadeUp .7s ease both; }
    .hero h1 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: clamp(2.8rem,7vw,5rem); color: #fff; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -.5px; animation: fadeUp .7s .1s ease both; }
    .hero h1 em { color: var(--gold); font-style: italic; }
    .hero p { color: rgba(255,255,255,.72); font-size: 1.1rem; margin: 1.4rem auto 2.4rem; max-width: 560px; line-height: 1.75; animation: fadeUp .7s .2s ease both; }
    .hero-btns { display: flex; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; animation: fadeUp .7s .3s ease both; }
    .btn-hero-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light)); color: var(--navy); border: none; padding: 15px 38px; border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--t), box-shadow var(--t); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; box-shadow: var(--sh-gold); }
    .btn-hero-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(212,160,23,.5); }
    .btn-hero-outline { background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4); padding: 14px 34px; border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: var(--t); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .btn-hero-outline:hover { border-color: var(--gold); background: rgba(212,160,23,.1); color: var(--gold-light); }
    .hero-scroll { position: absolute; bottom: 30px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; animation: fadeUp .7s .5s ease both; cursor: pointer; }
    .scroll-dot { width: 28px; height: 44px; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25); border-radius: 14px; display: flex; justify-content: center; padding-top: 8px; }
    .scroll-dot::after { content: ''; width: 4px; height: 8px; background: var(--gold); border-radius: 2px; animation: scrollBounce 1.8s infinite; }
    @keyframes scrollBounce { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1} 50%{transform:translateY(10px);opacity:.3} }
    @keyframes fadeUp { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }

    /* ── STATS BAR ── */
    .stats-bar { background: var(--white); box-shadow: var(--sh-md); position: relative; z-index: 10; }
    .stats-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .stat-item { flex: 1; min-width: 150px; padding: 26px 20px; text-align: center; border-right: 1px solid var(--gray-200); position: relative; }
    .stat-item:last-child { border-right: none; }
    .stat-num { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 2.3rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); display: block; line-height: 1; }
    .stat-label { color: var(--muted); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .8px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 4px; display: block; }
    .stat-item::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0); width: 40%; height: 3px; background: var(--gold); border-radius: 2px; transition: transform .4s ease; }
    .stat-item:hover::after { transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1); }

    /* ── SECTION LAYOUT ── */
    section { padding: 90px 5%; }
    .section-inner { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .section-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3rem; }
    .label-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--gold-pale); color: #8a6500; border: 1px solid rgba(212,160,23,.3); padding: 5px 16px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: .9rem; }
    .label-chip i { font-size: .85rem; }
    .section-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem); color: var(--navy); line-height: 1.15; }
    .title-line { width: 52px; height: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light)); border-radius: 4px; margin: 14px auto 0; }

    /* ── ABOUT ── */
    #about { background: var(--white); }
    .about-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 70px; align-items: center; }
    @media(max-width:800px) { .about-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .about-img-wrap { position: relative; }
    .about-img-main { width: 100%; height: 420px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: var(--r-lg); box-shadow: var(--sh-lg); }
    .about-img-badge { position: absolute; bottom: -20px; right: -20px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light)); color: var(--navy); padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: var(--r-md); font-weight: 800; font-size: .9rem; box-shadow: var(--sh-gold); text-align: center; }
    .about-img-badge span { display: block; font-size: 1.5rem; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; }
    .about-text .label-chip { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .about-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: clamp(2rem,3.5vw,2.8rem); color: var(--navy); line-height: 1.2; }
    .about-bar { width: 52px; height: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light)); border-radius: 4px; margin: 14px 0 1.6rem; }
    .about-text p { color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.85; margin-bottom: 1rem; font-size: .97rem; }
    .about-features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; margin-top: 2rem; }
    .af-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; background: var(--gray-100); border-radius: var(--r-sm); font-weight: 700; font-size: .88rem; color: var(--text); transition: background var(--t), box-shadow var(--t); cursor: default; }
    .af-item:hover { background: var(--gold-pale); box-shadow: var(--sh-sm); }
    .af-item i { color: var(--gold); font-size: 1.1rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

    /* ── QR SECTION ── */
    #qr-portal { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-mid) 50%, var(--navy-light) 100%); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
    #qr-portal::before { content:''; position:absolute; width:600px; height:600px; background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(212,160,23,.12) 0%, transparent 70%); top:-200px; right:-100px; border-radius:50%; }
    .qr-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; align-items: center; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    @media(max-width:800px) { .qr-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; text-align: center; } }
    .qr-text .label-chip { background: rgba(212,160,23,.15); color: var(--gold-light); border-color: rgba(212,160,23,.3); }
    .qr-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem); color: #fff; line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }
    .qr-title em { color: var(--gold); font-style: italic; }
    .qr-text p { color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); line-height: 1.8; font-size: .97rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    .qr-features { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
    .qr-features li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.8); font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 600; }
    .qr-features li i { color: var(--gold); font-size: 1rem; }
    .qr-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }
    .qr-card { background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-xl); padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.35); text-align: center; position: relative; }
    .qr-card::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:-2px; border-radius: calc(var(--r-xl) + 2px); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light), transparent 60%); z-index:-1; }
    .qr-canvas-wrap { background: var(--cream); padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--r-md); margin-bottom: 16px; display: inline-block; }
    .qr-canvas-wrap canvas { display: block; border-radius: 8px; }
    .qr-label { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .qr-url { font-size: .72rem; color: var(--muted); font-family: monospace; background: var(--gray-100); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; }
    .qr-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .qr-tab-btn { padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 50px; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: var(--t); }
    .qr-tab-btn.active, .qr-tab-btn:hover { background: var(--gold); color: var(--navy); border-color: var(--gold); }
    .qr-download { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); padding: 9px 22px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: var(--t); text-decoration: none; }
    .qr-download:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.2); color: #fff; }

    /* ── REGISTER ── */
    #register { background: var(--gray-100); }
    .reg-wrapper { max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-xl); box-shadow: var(--sh-lg); overflow: hidden; }
    .reg-header { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy), var(--navy-light)); padding: 28px 40px; }
    .step-track { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0; }
    .step-dot { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.15); color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: .82rem; transition: var(--t); flex-shrink: 0; cursor: pointer; border: 2px solid transparent; }
    .step-dot.active { background: var(--gold); color: var(--navy); border-color: var(--gold-light); box-shadow: var(--sh-gold); }
    .step-dot.done { background: #22c55e; color: #fff; border-color: #16a34a; }
    .step-line { flex: 1; height: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.15); margin: 0 4px; }
    .step-label { display: flex; gap: 0; flex: 1; margin-top: 8px; }
    .step-name { flex: 1; text-align: center; font-size: .7rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .5px; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .step-name.active { color: var(--gold-light); }
    .reg-body { padding: 44px; }
    .reg-step { display: none; animation: fadeUp .35s ease; }
    .reg-step.active { display: block; }
    .step-h { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.9rem; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 1.8rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .step-h i { color: var(--gold); font-size: 1.4rem; }
    .form-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    @media(max-width:600px) { .form-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .reg-body { padding: 24px; } }
    .form-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .form-group label { font-weight: 700; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--text); letter-spacing: .2px; }
    .form-group input, .form-group select, .form-group textarea { border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 12px 16px; font-size: .95rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; transition: border-color var(--t), box-shadow var(--t), background var(--t); background: var(--cream); color: var(--text); }
    .form-group input:focus, .form-group select:focus, .form-group textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--navy); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(10,22,40,.08); background: #fff; }
    .form-group input.error { border-color: var(--red); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(239,68,68,.1); }
    .error-msg { color: var(--red); font-size: .78rem; display: none; font-weight: 600; }
    .form-group input.error ~ .error-msg { display: block; }
    .reg-actions { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 28px; gap: 12px; }
    .btn-step-back { background: none; border: 2px solid var(--gray-200); color: var(--muted); padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: var(--t); font-size: .9rem; }
    .btn-step-back:hover { border-color: var(--navy); color: var(--navy); }
    .btn-step-next { background: var(--navy); color: #fff; border: none; padding: 13px 34px; border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--t), box-shadow var(--t); font-size: .9rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .btn-step-next:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(10,22,40,.3); }
    .btn-submit-final { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light)); color: var(--navy); border: none; padding: 14px 40px; border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--t), box-shadow var(--t); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .btn-submit-final:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--sh-gold); }
    .success-card { text-align: center; padding: 52px 20px; animation: fadeUp .5s ease; }
    .success-icon { font-size: 4.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; animation: pop .6s cubic-bezier(.18,.89,.32,1.28); display: inline-block; }
    @keyframes pop { 0%{transform:scale(0)} 70%{transform:scale(1.2)} 100%{transform:scale(1)} }
    .success-card h3 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 2.2rem; color: var(--navy); }
    .success-card p { color: var(--muted); margin-top: .5rem; }

    /* ── GALLERY ── */
    #gallery { background: var(--cream); }
    .gallery-filter { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
    .filter-btn { padding: 8px 22px; border-radius: 50px; border: 2px solid var(--gray-200); background: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: .83rem; cursor: pointer; transition: var(--t); color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .3px; }
    .filter-btn.active, .filter-btn:hover { border-color: var(--navy); background: var(--navy); color: #fff; }
    .gallery-masonry { columns: 3; gap: 16px; }
    @media(max-width:700px) { .gallery-masonry { columns: 2; } }
    @media(max-width:480px) { .gallery-masonry { columns: 1; } }
    .g-item { break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: var(--r-md); overflow: hidden; position: relative; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: var(--sh-sm); transition: transform var(--t), box-shadow var(--t); }
    .g-item:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--sh-md); }
    .g-item img { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; transition: transform .5s ease; }
    .g-item:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); }
    .g-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(10,22,40,.9) 0%, transparent 55%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 16px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--t); }
    .g-item:hover .g-overlay { opacity: 1; }
    .g-overlay span { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: .9rem; }
    .g-overlay small { color: var(--gold-light); font-size: .75rem; }
    .g-zoom { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.92); border-radius: 50%; width: 34px; height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1rem; opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--t); box-shadow: var(--sh-sm); color: var(--navy); }
    .g-item:hover .g-zoom { opacity: 1; }
    .lightbox { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,.92); z-index: 9999; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .lightbox.show { display: flex; animation: fadeUp .3s ease; }
    .lightbox img { max-width: 86vw; max-height: 78vh; border-radius: var(--r-md); box-shadow: var(--sh-lg); }
    .lb-close { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 28px; font-size: 2.5rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); cursor: pointer; line-height: 1; transition: color var(--t); }
    .lb-close:hover { color: var(--gold); }
    .lb-caption { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: .95rem; background: rgba(0,0,0,.5); padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 50px; white-space: nowrap; }

    /* ── NEWS ── */
    #news { background: var(--white); }
    .news-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .ntab { padding: 9px 24px; border: 2px solid var(--gray-200); background: var(--white); border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; transition: var(--t); font-size: .85rem; }
    .ntab.active, .ntab:hover { background: var(--navy); color: #fff; border-color: var(--navy); }
    .news-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 24px; }
    @media(max-width:800px) { .news-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); } }
    @media(max-width:500px) { .news-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .nc { background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-md); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--sh-sm); transition: transform var(--t), box-shadow var(--t); display: none; border: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }
    .nc.show { display: flex; flex-direction: column; animation: fadeUp .4s ease; }
    .nc:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--sh-md); }
    .nc-image { height: 190px; overflow: hidden; }
    .nc-image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform .5s ease; }
    .nc:hover .nc-image img { transform: scale(1.07); }
    .nc-body { padding: 22px; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .nc-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .tag-event { background: rgba(212,160,23,.12); color: #8a6500; }
    .tag-news { background: rgba(10,22,40,.08); color: var(--navy); }
    .tag-achievement { background: rgba(34,197,94,.1); color: #15803d; }
    .nc-body h5 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: .5rem; line-height: 1.3; }
    .nc-body p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .87rem; line-height: 1.65; flex: 1; }
    .nc-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }
    .nc-date { color: var(--muted); font-size: .77rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
    .nc-read { color: var(--navy); font-weight: 700; font-size: .82rem; text-decoration: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; transition: color var(--t); }
    .nc-read:hover { color: var(--gold); }

    /* ── DONATE ── */
    #donate { background: var(--gray-100); }
    .donate-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.15fr; gap: 44px; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; align-items: start; }
    @media(max-width:800px) { .donate-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .donate-info-img { width: 100%; height: 220px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: var(--r-lg); margin-bottom: 1.8rem; box-shadow: var(--sh-md); }
    .donate-info h3 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.8rem; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .donate-info p { color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 1.6rem; font-size: .95rem; }
    .impact-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
    .impact-list li { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; padding: 14px; background: #fff; border-radius: var(--r-sm); border: 1px solid var(--gray-200); transition: box-shadow var(--t); }
    .impact-list li:hover { box-shadow: var(--sh-sm); }
    .impact-icon { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--gold-pale); color: var(--gold); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 1.1rem; }
    .impact-text strong { display: block; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text); font-size: .92rem; }
    .impact-text span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .83rem; }
    .donate-card { background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-xl); padding: 36px; box-shadow: var(--sh-md); border: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }
    .donate-card h4 { font-weight: 800; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 1.3rem; font-size: 1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .amount-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,1fr); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
    .amt-btn { border: 2px solid var(--gray-200); background: var(--cream); border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 13px 6px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: var(--t); font-weight: 800; color: var(--navy); }
    .amt-btn span { display: block; font-size: 1rem; }
    .amt-btn small { font-size: .68rem; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }
    .amt-btn:hover, .amt-btn.active { border-color: var(--gold); background: var(--gold-pale); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(212,160,23,.2); }
    .progress-bar-wrap { margin: 22px 0; }
    .progress-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .progress-track { background: var(--gray-200); border-radius: 10px; height: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
    .progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light)); transition: width 1.2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); width: 0; }
    /* Payment tabs */
    .payment-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin: 18px 0 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .ptab { flex: 1; min-width: 72px; padding: 10px 8px; border: 2px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius: var(--r-sm); background: var(--cream); cursor: pointer; text-align: center; transition: var(--t); font-weight: 700; font-size: .78rem; color: var(--muted); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
    .ptab i { font-size: 1.25rem; }
    .ptab.active { border-color: var(--navy); background: var(--navy); color: #fff; }
    .ptab:hover:not(.active) { border-color: var(--navy-mid); color: var(--navy); }
    .payment-panel { display: none; animation: fadeUp .3s ease; }
    .payment-panel.active { display: block; }
    .card-number-wrap { position: relative; }
    .card-number-wrap input { padding-right: 52px; letter-spacing: 2px; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: .95rem; }
    .card-brand-icon { position: absolute; right: 14px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--muted); }
    .cvv-wrap { position: relative; }
    .cvv-toggle { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); background: none; border: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0; }
    .upi-logo-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .upi-logo { background: var(--white); border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--navy); cursor: pointer; transition: var(--t); box-shadow: var(--sh-sm); letter-spacing:.2px; }
    .upi-logo:hover { border-color: var(--gold); background: var(--gold-pale); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(212,160,23,.25); }
    /* UPI QR inside payment panel - Premium redesign */
    .upi-qr-box { margin-top: 20px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a1628 0%, #1e3a5f 100%); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 28px 20px 22px; text-align: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(10,22,40,.22); }
    .upi-qr-box::before { content:''; position:absolute; width:220px; height:220px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(212,160,23,.14) 0%, transparent 70%); top:-80px; right:-60px; border-radius:50%; pointer-events:none; }
    .upi-qr-box::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, transparent 24px, rgba(255,255,255,.018) 24px, rgba(255,255,255,.018) 25px); pointer-events:none; }
    .upi-qr-header { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:18px; position:relative; z-index:1; }
    .upi-qr-header i { color:var(--gold-light); font-size:1.1rem; }
    .upi-qr-header span { color:#fff; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.4px; }
    .upi-qr-frame { position:relative; display:inline-block; z-index:1; }
    .upi-qr-frame::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:-3px; border-radius:14px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light), rgba(212,160,23,.3), var(--gold)); z-index:-1; animation: qrGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
    @keyframes qrGlow { 0%,100%{ opacity:.8; } 50%{ opacity:1; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(212,160,23,.5); } }
    .upi-qr-inner { background: #fff; padding: 14px; border-radius: 11px; display:inline-block; }
    .upi-qr-box canvas { margin: 0 auto; border-radius: 4px; display:block; }
    .upi-qr-amount-badge { margin-top: 16px; position:relative; z-index:1; }
    .upi-qr-amount-label { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light)); color: var(--navy); font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 900; padding: 7px 20px; border-radius: 50px; letter-spacing:.3px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(212,160,23,.4); }
    .upi-qr-hint { color:rgba(255,255,255,.55); font-size:.72rem; margin-top:10px; position:relative; z-index:1; letter-spacing:.3px; }
    .upi-apps-row { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; margin-top:14px; position:relative; z-index:1; flex-wrap:wrap; }
    .upi-app-chip { background:rgba(255,255,255,.1); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); border-radius:6px; padding:4px 10px; font-size:.7rem; font-weight:700; color:rgba(255,255,255,.7); letter-spacing:.3px; }
    .upi-qr-amount-label-old { display:none; }
    .netbanking-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }
    .bank-btn { border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200); background: var(--cream); border-radius: 8px; padding: 11px 6px; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: var(--t); font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }
    .bank-btn:hover, .bank-btn.selected { border-color: var(--gold); background: var(--gold-pale); }
    .donate-btn-wrap { margin-top: 22px; }
    .btn-donate { width: 100%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-light)); color: var(--navy); border: none; padding: 16px; border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--t), box-shadow var(--t); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; box-shadow: var(--sh-gold); }
    .btn-donate:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(212,160,23,.5); }
    .secure-note { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 14px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .76rem; font-weight: 600; }
    .secure-note i { color: var(--green); font-size: .9rem; }
    /* PAYMENT SUCCESS MODAL */
    .pay-modal-overlay { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); z-index: 9999; align-items: center; justify-content: center; backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }
    .pay-modal-overlay.show { display: flex; }
    .pay-modal { background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-xl); padding: 50px 44px; text-align: center; max-width: 440px; width: 90%; box-shadow: var(--sh-lg); animation: fadeUp .4s ease; }
    .pay-modal .check-anim { font-size: 4.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; display: block; animation: pop .6s ease; }
    .pay-modal h3 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: .5rem; font-size: 2.2rem; }
    .pay-modal p { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.6; }
    .pay-modal .tx-id { background: var(--gray-100); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 18px; font-family: monospace; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 1.8rem; border: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }
    .btn-modal-close { background: var(--navy); color: #fff; border: none; padding: 13px 36px; border-radius: 50px; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: var(--t); }
    .btn-modal-close:hover { background: var(--navy-light); transform: translateY(-2px); }

    /* ── FOOTER ── */
    footer { background: var(--navy); color: rgba(255,255,255,.65); padding: 60px 5% 30px; }
    .footer-grid { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto 44px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 44px; }
    @media(max-width:800px) { .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
    @media(max-width:500px) { .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .footer-brand { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: .8rem; }
    .footer-brand em { color: var(--gold); font-style: normal; }
    footer p { font-size: .87rem; line-height: 1.75; max-width: 280px; }
    footer h6 { color: var(--gold-light); font-weight: 800; font-size: .82rem; margin-bottom: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: .8px; text-transform: uppercase; }
    footer ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; }
    footer ul a { color: rgba(255,255,255,.6); text-decoration: none; font-size: .87rem; transition: color var(--t); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
    footer ul a:hover { color: var(--gold); }
    footer ul a i { font-size: .75rem; opacity: .6; }
    .social-links { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 1.4rem; }
    .social-links a { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); color: rgba(255,255,255,.65); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1rem; transition: background var(--t), color var(--t), transform var(--t); text-decoration: none; }
    .social-links a:hover { background: var(--gold); color: var(--navy); transform: translateY(-3px); }
    .footer-bottom { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); padding-top: 22px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; font-size: .8rem; }
    .footer-bottom a { color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--t); }
    .footer-bottom a:hover { color: var(--gold); }

    /* ── BACK TO TOP ── */
    #backToTop { position: fixed; bottom: 28px; right: 28px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold); color: var(--navy); border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.1rem; box-shadow: var(--sh-gold); transition: var(--t); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); pointer-events: none; z-index: 800; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    #backToTop.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); pointer-events: all; }
    #backToTop:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(212,160,23,.5); }

    /* ── TOAST ── */
    .toast { position: fixed; bottom: 80px; right: 28px; background: var(--navy); color: #fff; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; z-index: 9999; box-shadow: var(--sh-md); transform: translateY(20px); opacity: 0; transition: var(--t); pointer-events: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    .toast i { color: var(--gold); }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- PRELOADER -->
<div id="preloader"><div class="loader-ring"></div></div>

<!-- BACK TO TOP -->
<button id="backToTop" title="Back to top" onclick="window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})"><i class="bi bi-arrow-up"></i></button>

<!-- TOAST -->
<div class="toast" id="toast"><i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill"></i><span id="toastMsg">Copied!</span></div>

<!-- NAVBAR -->
<nav class="navbar" id="mainNav">
  <div class="nav-inner">
    <a class="brand" href="#">
      <div class="brand-logo">A</div>
      <span class="brand-text"><em>Alumni</em>Connect</span>
    </a>
    <ul class="nav-links" id="navLinks">
      <li><a href="#about">About</a></li>
      <li><a href="#qr-portal">QR Portal</a></li>
      <li><a href="#register">Register</a></li>
      <li><a href="#gallery">Gallery</a></li>
      <li><a href="#news">News</a></li>
      <li><a href="#donate" class="nav-cta">Donate Now</a></li>
    </ul>
    <button class="hamburger" id="hamburger" aria-label="Menu"><span></span><span></span><span></span></button>
  </div>
</nav>

<!-- HERO -->
<section class="hero" id="home">
  <div class="hero-bg"></div>
  <div class="hero-overlay"></div>
  <div class="hero-particles" id="heroParticles"></div>
  <div class="hero-inner">
    <span class="hero-badge"><i class="bi bi-mortarboard-fill"></i> Class of 2025 Reunion</span>
    <h1>Welcome Back to<br><em>Our Alma Mater</em></h1>
    <p>Reconnect with classmates, celebrate achievements, and give back to the community that shaped who you are today.</p>
    <div class="hero-btns">
      <a href="#register" class="btn-hero-primary"><i class="bi bi-person-plus-fill"></i> Join the Network</a>
      <a href="#donate" class="btn-hero-outline"><i class="bi bi-heart-fill"></i> Make a Donation</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-scroll" onclick="document.getElementById('about').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">
    <div class="scroll-dot"></div>
    Scroll
  </div>
</section>

<!-- STATS BAR -->
<div class="stats-bar">
  <div class="stats-inner">
    <div class="stat-item"><span class="stat-num" data-target="12400">0</span><span class="stat-label">Alumni</span></div>
    <div class="stat-item"><span class="stat-num" data-target="48">0</span><span class="stat-label">Countries</span></div>
    <div class="stat-item"><span class="stat-num">₹2.4 Cr</span><span class="stat-label">Funds Raised</span></div>
    <div class="stat-item"><span class="stat-num" data-target="320">0</span><span class="stat-label">Events Hosted</span></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ABOUT -->
<section id="about">
  <div class="section-inner about-grid">
    <div class="about-img-wrap">
      <img class="about-img-main" src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1562774053-701939374585?w=900&auto=format&fit=crop&q=85" alt="University campus"/>
      <div class="about-img-badge"><span>40+</span> Years of<br>Excellence</div>
    </div>
    <div class="about-text">
      <span class="label-chip"><i class="bi bi-info-circle-fill"></i> Who We Are</span>
      <h2 class="about-title">Building Bridges Between Generations</h2>
      <div class="about-bar"></div>
      <p>The Alumni Portal is your gateway to a vibrant global community of graduates. Stay connected, grow professionally, and help shape the next generation of students.</p>
      <p>From mentorship programmes to annual reunions, we offer countless ways to give back and stay involved with the institution that started it all.</p>
      <div class="about-features">
        <div class="af-item"><i class="bi bi-patch-check-fill"></i> Mentorship Programs</div>
        <div class="af-item"><i class="bi bi-calendar-event-fill"></i> Annual Reunions</div>
        <div class="af-item"><i class="bi bi-briefcase-fill"></i> Career Network</div>
        <div class="af-item"><i class="bi bi-heart-fill"></i> Scholarship Funds</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>



<!-- REGISTER -->
<section id="register">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <div class="section-header">
      <span class="label-chip"><i class="bi bi-person-plus-fill"></i> Join Us</span>
      <h2 class="section-title">Alumni Registration</h2>
      <div class="title-line"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="reg-wrapper">
      <div class="reg-header">
        <div class="step-track">
          <div class="step-dot active" id="dot1">1</div>
          <div class="step-line"></div>
          <div class="step-dot" id="dot2">2</div>
          <div class="step-line"></div>
          <div class="step-dot" id="dot3">3</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="reg-body">
        <!-- Step 1 -->
        <div class="reg-step active" id="step1">
          <div class="step-h"><i class="bi bi-person-fill"></i> Personal Details</div>
          <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group"><label>First Name</label><input type="text" id="fname" placeholder="Aarav"/><span class="error-msg">Please enter your first name</span></div>
            <div class="form-group"><label>Last Name</label><input type="text" id="lname" placeholder="Shah"/><span class="error-msg">Please enter your last name</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="form-group"><label>Email Address</label><input type="email" id="email" placeholder="aarav@email.com"/><span class="error-msg">Please enter a valid email</span></div>
          <div class="form-group"><label>Phone Number</label><input type="tel" placeholder="+91 98765 43210"/></div>
          <div class="reg-actions"><span></span><button class="btn-step-next" onclick="goStep(2)">Next Step <i class="bi bi-arrow-right"></i></button></div>
        </div>
        <!-- Step 2 -->
        <div class="reg-step" id="step2">
          <div class="step-h"><i class="bi bi-mortarboard-fill"></i> Academic Info</div>
          <div class="form-row">
            <div class="form-group"><label>Graduation Year</label><select><option value="">Select year</option><option>2025</option><option>2024</option><option>2023</option><option>2022</option><option>2021</option><option>2020</option><option>2019</option></select></div>
            <div class="form-group"><label>Department</label><select><option value="">Select dept.</option><option>Computer Science</option><option>Electronics</option><option>Mechanical</option><option>Civil</option><option>MBA</option></select></div>
          </div>
          <div class="form-group"><label>Current Employer / Organisation</label><input type="text" placeholder="Google, Infosys, Self-employed..."/></div>
          <div class="form-group"><label>LinkedIn Profile URL</label><input type="url" placeholder="https://linkedin.com/in/yourprofile"/></div>

<script>
/* ══ PRELOADER ══ */
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('preloader').classList.add('hidden'), 400);
});

/* ══ NAVBAR SCROLL ══ */
const nav = document.getElementById('mainNav');
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 50);
  document.getElementById('backToTop').classList.toggle('visible', window.scrollY > 400);
});

/* ══ HAMBURGER ══ */
document.getElementById('hamburger').addEventListener('click', function() {
  this.classList.toggle('open');
  document.getElementById('navLinks').classList.toggle('open');
});
document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.getElementById('navLinks').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('hamburger').classList.remove('open');
}));

/* ══ HERO PARTICLES ══ */
const particleContainer = document.getElementById('heroParticles');
for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
  const s = document.createElement('span');
  const size = Math.random() * 6 + 2;
  s.style.cssText = `width:${size}px;height:${size}px;left:${Math.random()*100}%;top:${Math.random()*100}%;--dur:${6+Math.random()*8}s;--delay:${Math.random()*-10}s;--tx:${(Math.random()-0.5)*60}px;--ty:${(Math.random()-0.5)*60}px;--op:${Math.random()*.2+.05}`;
  particleContainer.appendChild(s);
}

/* ══ COUNTER ANIMATION ══ */
function animateCounter(el, target) {
  let start = 0, duration = 2000, startTime = null;
  const suffix = target > 100 ? '+' : '';
  function step(ts) {
    if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
    const progress = Math.min((ts - startTime) / duration, 1);
    const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
    el.textContent = Math.floor(ease * target).toLocaleString('en-IN') + suffix;
    if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
const counterObs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  entries.forEach(e => {
    if (e.isIntersecting && e.target.dataset.target) {
      animateCounter(e.target, parseInt(e.target.dataset.target));
      counterObs.unobserve(e.target);
    }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.5 });
document.querySelectorAll('.stat-num[data-target]').forEach(el => counterObs.observe(el));

/* ══ TOAST ══ */
function showToast(msg) {
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  document.getElementById('toastMsg').textContent = msg;
  t.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 3000);
}

/* ══ QR CODE SYSTEM ══ */
const QR_URLS = {
  register: 'https://alumniconnect.edu/register',
  donate:   'https://alumniconnect.edu/donate',
  gallery:  'https://alumniconnect.edu/gallery',
  news:     'https://alumniconnect.edu/news'
};
const QR_LABELS = {
  register: 'Alumni Registration',
  donate:   'Make a Donation',
  gallery:  'Campus Gallery',
  news:     'News & Events'
};
let currentQrKey = 'register';

function generateQR(canvasId, url, size) {
  QRCode.toCanvas(document.getElementById(canvasId), url, {
    width: size, margin: 1,
    color: { dark: '#0a1628', light: '#faf8f4' }
  }, err => { if (err) console.error('QR Error:', err); });
}

function switchQR(key, btn) {
  currentQrKey = key;
  document.querySelectorAll('.qr-tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('qrCardLabel').textContent = QR_LABELS[key];
  document.getElementById('qrUrlDisplay').textContent = QR_URLS[key].replace('https://','');
  generateQR('mainQrCanvas', QR_URLS[key], 200);
}

function downloadQR(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const canvas = document.getElementById('mainQrCanvas');
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.download = `alumni-${currentQrKey}-qr.png`;
  link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
  link.click();
  showToast('QR code downloaded!');
}

function copyQRUrl() {
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(QR_URLS[currentQrKey])
    .then(() => showToast('Link copied to clipboard!'))
    .catch(() => showToast('Link: ' + QR_URLS[currentQrKey]));
}

/* ══ UPI QR (live, updates on amount/ID change) ══ */
function buildUpiString() {
  const amt = selectedAmount === 'custom' ? (document.getElementById('customAmount').value || '1') : selectedAmount;
  const upiId = document.getElementById('upiId').value.trim() || 'alumniconnect@upi';
  return `upi://pay?pa=${upiId}&pn=AlumniConnect&am=${amt}&cu=INR&tn=AlumniDonation`;
}

function updateUpiQR() {
  const amt = selectedAmount === 'custom' ? (document.getElementById('customAmount').value || '?') : selectedAmount;
  const formatted = isNaN(parseInt(amt)) ? amt : parseInt(amt).toLocaleString('en-IN');
  const textEl = document.getElementById('upiAmountText');
  if (textEl) textEl.textContent = formatted;
}

/* ══ INIT QR ON LOAD ══ */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  updateUpiQR();
  const customInput = document.getElementById('customAmount');
  if (customInput) customInput.addEventListener('input', () => { selectedAmount = customInput.value || '0'; updateDonateBtn(); updateUpiQR(); });
});

/* ══ REGISTRATION MULTI-STEP ══ */
let currentStep = 1;
function goStep(n) {
  document.getElementById('step' + currentStep).classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('dot' + currentStep).classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('dot' + currentStep).classList.add('done');
  document.getElementById('dot' + currentStep).innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i>';
  currentStep = n;
  const stepEl = document.getElementById('step' + n);
  if (stepEl) {
    stepEl.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('dot' + n).classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('dot' + n).classList.remove('done');
    document.getElementById('dot' + n).textContent = n;
  }
}
function submitForm() {
  document.getElementById('step3').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('dot3').classList.add('done');
  document.getElementById('dot3').innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-lg"></i>';
  document.getElementById('stepSuccess').classList.add('active');
  showToast('Registration successful! 🎓');
}

/* ══ GALLERY FILTER ══ */
document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
  btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    this.classList.add('active');
    const f = this.dataset.filter;
    document.querySelectorAll('.g-item').forEach(item => {
      item.style.display = (f === 'all' || item.dataset.cat === f) ? 'block' : 'none';
    });
  });
});
function openLightbox(src, caption) {
  document.getElementById('lb-img').src = src;
  document.getElementById('lb-caption').textContent = caption;
  document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closeLightbox() {
  document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
document.getElementById('lightbox').addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeLightbox(); });
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLightbox(); });

/* ══ NEWS FILTER ══ */
function filterNews(type, el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.ntab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.nc').forEach(card => {
    card.classList.toggle('show', type === 'all' || card.dataset.type === type);
  });
}

/* ══ DONATION AMOUNT ══ */
let selectedAmount = '500';
function selectAmount(el, val) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.amt-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');
  selectedAmount = val;
  const wrap = document.getElementById('customAmountWrap');
  wrap.style.display = val === 'custom' ? 'flex' : 'none';
  if (val === 'custom') selectedAmount = document.getElementById('customAmount').value || '0';
  updateDonateBtn();
  updateUpiQR();
}
function updateDonateBtn() {
  const display = (selectedAmount === 'custom' || selectedAmount === '0') ? '?' : '₹' + parseInt(selectedAmount).toLocaleString('en-IN');
  document.getElementById('donateBtnText').textContent = 'Donate ' + display + ' Now';
}

/* ══ PAYMENT TABS ══ */
function switchPayTab(tab, el) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.ptab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.payment-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('panel-' + tab).classList.add('active');
  if (tab === 'upi') setTimeout(updateUpiQR, 50);
}

/* ══ CARD FORMATTING ══ */
function formatCardNum(input) {
  let v = input.value.replace(/\D/g,'').substring(0,16);
  input.value = v.replace(/(.{4})/g,'$1  ').trim();
  const icon = document.getElementById('cardBrandIcon');
  if (v.startsWith('4')) icon.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-credit-card-2-front-fill" style="color:#1a1f71;"></i>';
  else if (v.startsWith('5')) icon.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-credit-card-2-front-fill" style="color:#eb001b;"></i>';
  else if (v.startsWith('3')) icon.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-credit-card-fill" style="color:#007bc1;"></i>';
  else icon.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-credit-card"></i>';
}
function formatExpiry(input) {
  let v = input.value.replace(/\D/g,'').substring(0,4);
  if (v.length >= 2) v = v.substring(0,2) + ' / ' + v.substring(2);
  input.value = v;
}
function toggleCvv(btn) {
  const input = btn.previousElementSibling;
  input.type = input.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
  btn.innerHTML = input.type === 'password' ? '<i class="bi bi-eye"></i>' : '<i class="bi bi-eye-slash"></i>';
}
function fillUpiHint(suffix) {
  const upiInput = document.getElementById('upiId');
  const current = upiInput.value.split('@')[0] || 'yourname';
  upiInput.value = current + suffix;
  upiInput.focus();
  updateUpiQR();
}
function selectBank(el) {
  el.closest('.netbanking-grid').querySelectorAll('.bank-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  el.classList.add('selected');
}

/* ══ PROCESS DONATION ══ */
function processDonation() {
  const activeTab = document.querySelector('.ptab.active').textContent.trim().toLowerCase();
  let valid = true, msg = '';
  if (activeTab.includes('card')) {
    const name = document.getElementById('cardName').value.trim();
    const num = document.getElementById('cardNum').value.replace(/\s/g,'');
    const exp = document.getElementById('cardExpiry').value.trim();
    const cvv = document.getElementById('cardCvv').value.trim();
    if (!name) { msg = 'Please enter cardholder name.'; valid = false; }
    else if (num.length < 16) { msg = 'Please enter a valid 16-digit card number.'; valid = false; }
    else if (exp.length < 7) { msg = 'Please enter a valid expiry date.'; valid = false; }
    else if (cvv.length < 3) { msg = 'Please enter CVV.'; valid = false; }
  } else if (activeTab.includes('upi')) {
    const upi = document.getElementById('upiId').value.trim();
    if (!upi.includes('@')) { msg = 'Please enter a valid UPI ID (e.g. name@upi).'; valid = false; }
  } else if (activeTab.includes('net')) {
    if (!document.getElementById('nbUserId').value.trim() || !document.getElementById('nbPass').value.trim()) { msg = 'Please enter net banking credentials.'; valid = false; }
  } else if (activeTab.includes('wallet')) {
    if (document.getElementById('walletPhone').value.trim().length < 10) { msg = 'Please enter a valid mobile number.'; valid = false; }
  }
  if (!valid) { showToast('⚠️ ' + msg); return; }
  const txId = 'ALM-' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2,10).toUpperCase();
  document.getElementById('txId').textContent = 'Transaction ID: ' + txId;
  document.getElementById('payModal').classList.add('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
}
function closePayModal() {
  document.getElementById('payModal').classList.remove('show');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

/* ══ PROGRESS BAR ANIMATION ══ */
const progressObs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
  entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) { document.getElementById('progressFill').style.width = '68%'; progressObs.unobserve(e.target); } });
}, { threshold: 0.3 });
const donateSection = document.getElementById('donate');
if (donateSection) progressObs.observe(donateSection);
</script>
</body>
</html>
